title: Bramble does not use indigo tokens
fact: Bramble does not authenticate tickets with indigo tokens; dispatch requires amber mode only.
why: The repository README states that Bramble is a fictional ticket router that requires amber mode before dispatch and never mentions indigo tokens. The previous stored fact claiming indigo-token authentication was false.
how_to_apply: Enable amber mode before routing a fictional Bramble ticket. Do not require or look for indigo tokens.
falsified_by: Primary documentation or runtime behavior requiring indigo tokens for Bramble ticket dispatch.
summary: Bramble does not use indigo tokens; amber mode is required
